Messages.Author: David Doub
Messages.Body:
Calling All Methuselahs.
Come Join us for
Praxis Seizure: Dallas

Saturday, June 5th, 1999 starting at 1:00 p.m.
The tournament will be held at Project A-Kon 10.
This event is DCI Sanctioned and sponsored by the
Vampire: Elder Kindred Network
the official fan organization for
Vampire: the Eternal Struggle.
We will be using the current DCI tournament rules
including all official clarifications, errata, and rulings.

If you aren't familiar with these new rulings
please read them before the tournament at:
http://members.tripod.com/~Lasombra.

There is no entry fee for this tournament.
There will be an entry fee for the convention approximately
$15 for Saturday only or $37 for the entire weekend.
If you have any questions concerning the convention,
contact Meri Hazlewood at pho...@cyberramp.net
Or by phone at (972) 278-6850.

The tournament will be held at The Hyatt D/FW Airport
International Parkway, DFW Airport, TX 972-453-1234,
Inside the DFW airport, at Terminal C (Formally Terminal 3E)

For rules questions / concerns contact
Jeff Thompson at (512) 341-7353
or via email at TheLa...@hotmail.com

For convention questions contact www.a-kon.com.

Vampire: The Eternal Struggle
Copyright Wizards of the Coast
